name: Rclone Drive Monitor
author: m4teo
description: Bar widget to monitor and control an rclone cloud storage mount (Google Drive and others).

barWidget.description: Watch and control an rclone mount (Google Drive and others): mount, unmount, and view free space from the bar.

schema.label: Remote name
schema.description: Name of the rclone remote to monitor (as configured in 'rclone config').

schema.label: Mount point
schema.description: Local path where the remote is mounted.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Show desktop notifications when the mount goes up or down.
